Home / Services / Business consultancy

Business strategy.

Bring a founder or management team together around the decisions, responsibilities and measures that will move the business forward.

Discuss this service View brief

Scope of work.

Diagnose the business

Review priorities, costs, customers and how work flows through the team. Agree on the decisions that matter most before starting a wider change programme.

Turn decisions into a plan

Document owners, milestones and a short list of performance measures. The plan can combine growth strategy, financial modelling and operational improvement.

Build a review rhythm

Choose a defined assessment, a project or ongoing advisory support. Regular reviews make it clear when a decision or adjustment is needed.

What you receive.

  • Diagnostic project — a two-to-four-week review ending with written findings and an owned action plan.
  • Monthly advisory — scheduled planning sessions, KPI reviews and support between meetings.
  • Implementation support — process or tool setup, staff training and handover documents.

Common questions.

Can you help carry out the plan?

Yes. Implementation support can follow the assessment so the people doing the work have help with processes, tools and training.

Can a founder based abroad use the service?

Yes. Meetings and progress reviews can happen remotely. Legal filings, tax or audit work are coordinated with the appropriate licensed professionals.

How is a project priced?

After the free initial conversation, you receive the proposed scope and fee in writing.
